pattern.description: Regular-expression pattern to search for by default; use literal=true to treat it as exact text.

path.description: Directory or file path to search. A relative value resolves against `workdir`; an absolute value needs no `workdir`.

workdir.description: Optional absolute directory on the target daemon's file system used to resolve a relative `path`. Required when `path` is relative; an absolute `path` may omit it, and then results are absolute paths. It is never inherited from a previous call, a session default, or the environment root. Provide an expanded absolute path (no '~', no environment variable placeholders); Windows targets use a drive-rooted or UNC path.

include.description: Optional file filter glob such as `**/*.ts`.

literal.description: Treat the pattern literally instead of as a regular expression. Defaults to false.

multiline.description: Allow a match to span multiple lines. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Positive maximum number of matches to return. Defaults to 100.

timeout_seconds.description: Positive search timeout in seconds. Defaults to 60 (1 minute).
